notes: Medium (total 13). Four independent data-integrity pipelines, each requiring exact, byte/numeric-correct output that the verifier independently recomputes (quantitative_correctness=3): (1) reproducible GNU tar that must not dereference symlinks, must carry >100-char and deeply nested member names verbatim, and must stamp EVERY member mtime with the env-provided BUILD_EPOCH (or the fallback 1630454400), verified by re-running the archive builder against a hidden source tree with a fresh epoch (hidden_case_generalization=3); (2) a splitter that must fragment an oversized stream into chunks each ≤ a byte cap and keep them reassembleable via a recorded inverse, so the round trip is byte-exact for hidden non-multiple, exact-multiple and tiny-cap inputs (dependent_stages=2: split then join); (3) extracting a target member from a password-encrypted 7z archive using the on-disk credential by actually running the extraction; (4) a digested-tree walker that applies PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (fixed hex salt, 100000 iterations, 32-byte key) to every regular file and emits sorted relpath/tab/digest lines, checked by recomputation on both the visible tree and a hidden nested tree with binary and empty files. tool_breadth=2 (tar, p7zip/7z, python/hashlib). Reasoning is shallow per stage (reasoning_depth=1) but exactly-correct bytes/mtimes/digests are required; an imprecise epoch, a dereferenced symlink, a malformed chunk, or a wrong salt fails the corresponding gate. An agent missing any single competency fails at least one independent check; no deliverable is derivable from the pristine image.
